_comment: EXPERIMENT: optional extra quests. Not original game content. Each stage list names BOTH worlds where a place exists twice (Asuka and Amaterasu), so a quest works whichever world the story is in. Species names, stage ids and item names are checked against the game's own data by tools/check_quests.py.

quests.title: Central Park pest control
quests.text: Kunemon keep wandering into Central Park. Thin them out.

quests.title: Wire Forest survey
quests.text: Walk the Wire Forest entrance and the forest beyond it, and report back.
